title: assign_scenarios from lead (lead-yy30)
notes:
Lead work_id: lead-yy30
clarify: These 5 scenarios pin behavior across three layers that this BC currently does not implement and whose deliverable shape the message does not define, so I cannot determine what artifact constitutes 'done' for a faithful test. Specifically: (1) Repo-artifact scenario d9909f38 (Dockerfile exists at a tracked path, installs utility CLIs in the github.com/dstengle/<utility> @ vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH pin shape) — should the deliverable be an actual committed Dockerfile at the repo root, pinned by a file-tree-inspection BDD step? (2) CI/registry scenarios b688a5fe (tag push -> publish vX + latest to ghcr, public, unauthenticated docker pull) and 4e470f7 (repository_dispatch -> rebuild -> new digest D_new on latest) and be11d615 (re-tag latest to a prior digest D_good) assert outcomes about a LIVE ghcr.io registry and SUCCESSFUL real GitHub Actions runs. This BC's entire BDD harness is in-memory fakes with no network/registry seam and there is no .github/workflows dir today. What is the intended deliverable and pin layer for these three: committed .github/workflows/*.yml authored and pinned STRUCTURALLY (like the existing shared-postgres scenarios bb070f75/8ad37d1a that the conftest tests structurally), OR a new in-src registry-driver seam with a fake that simulates digest/tag resolution, OR both? (3) Launch-path scenario af2f03d3 asserts 'launch resolves the bc-base latest tag against the registry and pulls digest D_new before starting' and the started container 'is running from image digest D_new'. Today controller.launch hardcodes BC_IMAGE='ghcr.io/dstengle/shopsystem-bc-base:latest' with no digest resolution and no registry driver; implementing exactly what the Then steps assert requires introducing a registry-resolution seam whose interface the message does not specify. Should launch gain an explicit digest-resolution step (e.g. docker pull/inspect RepoDigests of latest) injected via a new RegistryDriver protocol fakeable in tests, and is that the same seam intended for scenarios 2? Confirming the per-scenario deliverable and pin layer for (2) and (3) is required before I can write tests the lead would agree pin the asserted behavior.
